item.title: 1990 Chevrolet Corvette ZR-1 at No Reserve
item.description: This 1990 Chevrolet Corvette ZR-1 is powered by a 5.7-liter LT5 V8 paired with a ZF six-speed manual transmission. The car is finished in Bright Red over black leather and is equipped with the Selective Ride and Handling Package, two removable roof panels, pop-up headlights, 17" aluminum wheels, power-adjustable sport seats, air conditioning, and a Delco Bose Gold Series sound system with a CD player. item.title: 25k-Mile 2012 Ram 3500 Laramie Longhorn Mega Cab Cummins 4×4
item.description: This 2012 Ram 3500 Laramie Longhorn is a Mega Cab 4×4 pickup that primarily spent time in Vermont and New York before it was acquired by the selling dealer—a BaT Local Partner—in late 2025. item.title: 5.3L Vortec-Powered 1966 Toyota Land Cruiser FJ40
item.description: This 1966 Toyota Land Cruiser FJ40 was purchased by the seller in 2022 and subsequently underwent modifications that included installing a remanufactured 5.3-liter Vortec V8, a 4L60E four-speed automatic transmission, and an NP231J dual-range transfer case. The truck rides on a lifted suspension with King Off-Road shocks, Eibach springs, a BDS dual steering stabilizer, and Currie Antirock rear sway bars over 17" Black Rhino wheels and hydroboosted four-wheel disc brakes. item.title: 1995 Porsche 911 Carrera Coupe 6-Speed
item.description: This 1995 Porsche 911 Carrera coupe was specified in black over a Cashmere Beige leather interior with heated sport seats, and it was optioned with a limited-slip differential. Shifting is through a six-speed manual transaxle, and power is provided by a 3.6-liter flat-six that received a top-end rebuild under previous ownership. item.description: This 2005 BMW M3 coupe was specified new with the Competition Package, and it is powered by a 3.2-liter inline-six linked with a six-speed manual transmission and a limited-slip differential. The car was acquired by the seller in 2013, and it has been retrofitted with a 4.10:1 limited-slip differential, an aftermarket cat-back exhaust system, an aluminum radiator, and a short shifter. item.title: 956-Mile 2017 Acura NSX
item.description: This 2017 Acura NSX has 956 miles and has been modified with an AimGain carbon-fiber body kit in addition to an Fi exhaust system, 20" and 21" Vossen multi-spoke wheels, and an Air Lift Performance suspension. item.title: Euro 1995 Ferrari F512 M
item.description: This 1995 Ferrari F512 M is a left-hand-drive, European-market car that is said to have spent time in Japan from approximately 2020 until it was imported to the US in 2025 and acquired by the selling dealer later that year. Finished in Rosso Corsa over black Connolly leather, the vehicle is powered by a 4.9-liter flat-12 paired with a five-speed manual transaxle.
